name: Ricardo Vargas Mendoza
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. He started his career as a car body repairman in Lima, honing his skills in panel beating and refinishing. A local racing team, impressed by his meticulous work, recruited him to handle the paintwork for their cars. He found the fast-paced environment exhilarating and quickly adapted to the unique demands of motorsport. 

Ricardo approaches his work with a pragmatic and detail-oriented mindset. He's known for his ability to consistently deliver high-quality finishes under pressure, ensuring the cars not only look good but also have a durable and aerodynamic paint job. His understanding of paint technology and application techniques allows him to troubleshoot problems effectively and find innovative solutions to achieve the best possible results. He is particularly skilled at creating vibrant and durable liveries that stand out on the track, while also being easy to repair and maintain between races.

What sets Ricardo apart is his calm demeanor and ability to remain focused even when deadlines are tight and the pressure is on. He's a valuable asset to any team, providing a steady hand and a commitment to excellence.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium build with a focused gaze and a reassuring smile.

quirks: Always keeps a small Peruvian flag on his workbench.
Insists on using only natural light when matching colors.
Has a lucky paint brush he uses for the final clear coat.
